mainRoof.notes: One tall, steep, symmetrical gable roof over the whole building including the garage; no dormers, no cross gables, no valleys. Louvred vent slot in each gable peak. Low-slope porch roof wraps the front and left sides below the main eaves. Pitch not stated (drawn roughly 45 degrees; ridge height 9.55 m over a single storey).

uncertain: FRONT is read from renders and plan only (no front elevation drawing). Order left to right: living-room double window, entrance door, bedroom-3 double window, narrow bathroom window, bedroom-2 double window, two single garage doors.

REAR: the master-bedroom window + double door + window are separated only by narrow posts and share one head, so they are counted as ONE LARGE_GLAZING; read separately they would be WINDOW, GLAZED_DOOR, WINDOW (rear count 6 instead of 4). The first opening (far left seen from behind) is the garage's rear service door with glazed lites.
LEFT: living-room slider is 8 ft (2.44 m) wide - on the GLAZED_DOOR / LARGE_GLAZING boundary.
Render 7 draws only three porch posts; render 18 and the plan show six along the front.
No attic plan and vaulted ceilings: attic treated as not habitable although the roof is very tall.
Whether the shop/garage should count as a separate body is a judgement call: it is inside the same rectangular volume under the same roof.
Chimney is black/dark in one render and grey block in the other; rear-facade colours are not shown in colour anywhere.
confidence: HIGH for counts on rear/left/right (labelled elevation drawings + plan) and for massing; MEDIUM for the front, which has no elevation drawing and relies on two renders plus the plan.
